description: Compare DNS responses across the nine currently configured public and authoritative resolvers to detect propagation lag, missing answers, or differing record sets. Each resolver's answer is compared as a whole RRset (order, case of names and trailing dots ignored; TXT case kept; TTLs ignored, as caches count them down). Defaults to record type A and region 'all'. Returns every resolver response, how many resolvers were queried, answered and failed, and `percentage` = share of the answering resol

domain.description: DNS name, e.g. example.com, _spf.google.com or _dmarc.example.com (no URL, path, or port)

name: intodns__check_dns_propagation
